note: Banco República's particular conditions for its Visa credit cards (undated): the Internacional card's yearly charge is 1,281 pesos with VAT, waived in full on average spending of 35,000 pesos a month the year before, written as 420,000 in the year (half of it on 25,000 a month, a step not written); balances in pesos bear an effective 65.00% a year.
